full_description:
We are a Sydney-based startup launching a local digital advertising network that runs on venues' own screens. Venues with a smart Android TV / Google TV (or Android TV box) with Google Play Store install our free app, and nearby businesses can book ad time on their screen.

We're engaging independent contractors in Sydney to introduce this offer to venue owners and help them sign up.

THE TASK
Get local venue owners/managers to sign up using your unique referral link and link their screen.
- Target venues: cafés, barbershops, hair/beauty salons, gyms and similar walk-in businesses that already have a smart Android TV / Google TV or Android TV box with Google Play Store
- Area: Sydney metro only

PAY – RESULTS ONLY
- $10 AUD per verified venue sign-up
- Paid via Freelancer milestones in batches of 10 verified sign-ups
- No hourly rate, retainer or minimum – you are paid only for verified results

WHAT COUNTS AS A VERIFIED SIGN-UP
- A real, operating walk-in business in Sydney metro, listed on Google Maps
- The venue already has a smart Android TV / Google TV or Android TV box with Google Play Store (we do not supply screens)
- The owner/manager completes the sign-up themselves (or with you present) using your referral link, including verifying their own mobile number
- Valid, active ABN for the business
- The owner installs our TV app from Google Play and links at least one screen to their account, and the screen shows online
- We call the business on its publicly listed number to confirm the owner agreed
- Not already in our system (duplicates are not paid)
Verification is completed within 5 business days. Sign-ups found to be fake, duplicated or made without the owner's agreement are not paid; any amount already paid for them is deducted from future payments, and the contract may be ended.

HOW YOU WORK (INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR)
- You must hold your own active Australian ABN and invoice under it
- You decide your own hours, days, suburbs and approach
- You use your own phone, transport and resources, at your own cost
- You're free to work for other businesses at the same time
- You may use your own helpers at your own cost and responsibility
- We provide a short overview of the offer and our conduct rules – how you reach owners is up to you

CONDUCT RULES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- Tell venue owners you are an independent referrer and that you are paid for referrals
- No false or exaggerated claims (e.g. no promises of earnings, free hardware or contract terms)
- No pressure tactics; respect a "no"
- Only submit sign-ups the owner genuinely agreed to
- Don't keep or reuse owners' personal details

SEPARATE ONGOING REFERRAL PROGRAM (OPTIONAL)
Separately from this Freelancer task, contractors may choose to join our platform's own referral program under its own terms. Earnings there depend entirely on actual results under those terms and are not guaranteed. Details are provided after award; joining is optional and does not affect this task.

STARTING BATCH
First milestone: 10 verified sign-ups ($100 AUD). Contractors with good-quality sign-ups will be offered further batches.

IN YOUR BID, PLEASE INCLUDE
1. Your Sydney suburb(s) / areas you can cover
2. Your ABN (we verify it on ABN Lookup)
3. Whether you already know venue owners (cafés, barbers, gyms, etc.)
4. Any sales, hospitality, retail or local business experience

Australia-based contractors with an active ABN only. Bids without an ABN will not be considered.
